Using the ctor:

public Mailer(final String host, final int port, final String username, final String password)

in my environment causes the port to be ignored. JavaMail substitutes the default port of 25 instead.

[main] ERROR org.codemonkey.vesijama.Mailer - Could not connect to SMTP host: localhost, port: 25


After a lot of thrashing, I found the root cause  at line 130 in Mailer.java; JavaMail expects all property values to be Strings.

     props.put("mail.smtp.port", port);

should be

     props.put("mail.smtp.port", String.valueOf(port));


Something very strange that I can't explain is that running the class MailTest worked OK from a checkout of the project, but copying the same *exact* file into my project would cause it fail. I can only assume that some bits of my project/classpath setup are causing the problem.

Thanks!
Uriah Carpenter
Widen Enterprises, Inc.

Hello Uriah,

Thanks for the report! It should be fixed in releas v1.5.
